items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Because my bass player, I had a great bass player named Dan LeBlanc, he died prematurely.

ctx.x: Well he was a regular guy.

Oh, listen, musicians, there's a rule of regulars. Take it from me. I know my band, I can show you pictures where they're laughing and they're jolly and they all love one another. And they love their leader in spite of what people think. But they used to try to put me on in lots of ways. I remember I used to, as I tell you, I would take anything to make money and keep them busy. Because my bass player, I had a great bass player named Dan LeBlanc, he died prematurely. He told me one night we would play with you…
